# porkbun_url_forwards (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "porkbun_url_forwards" "test" {
  domain = "jiancodes.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) The domain name.

### Read-Only

- `url_forwards` (Attributes Set) List of URL forwards. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--url_forwards))

<a id="nestedatt--url_forwards"></a>
### Nested Schema for `url_forwards`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The record ID.
- `include_path` (Boolean) Whether to append the request URI path to the forwarding destination.
- `location` (String) The destination URL to forward to.
- `redirect_type` (String) The exact redirect type; takes precedence over `type` when supplied. `301` = permanent, `302` or `307` = temporary (this is how you request 307), `masked` = URL masking.
- `subdomain` (String) The subdomain portion only (optional, leave blank or omit for root domain). Alphanumeric and hyphens only.
- `type` (String) Redirect kind. `permanent` = HTTP 301; `temporary` = HTTP 302 (default); `masked` = loads the destination in a frame (URL masking).
- `wildcard` (Boolean) Whether to also forward all subdomains of the forwarded subdomain.
